$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: Capiá

extraction.method: First-party stylesheet read (the single hand-authored Vite bundle assets/index-Cl1L7_-h.css, unminified), first-party behaviour script read (assets/index-DrOw2l_V.js), Playwright Chromium computed-style spot checks, interaction sweep, and 1440px/768px/390px captures
extraction.evidence: Original references are retained in docs/design-references/capia and the section specifications in docs/research/capia.
extraction.note: A warm, hand-made neighbourhood-burger system: charcoal and bread-cream canvases, a cheddar accent, tomato and mate secondaries, a variable grotesque cut condensed for display and a brush script for the 'calma' voice, organic bread-shaped radii and slight rotations everywhere.

--bg.reason: The page canvas (body background) is the bread-cream 'pão'.

--surface.reason: Lifted light surfaces (hero CTA, e-mail field, white seal) use 'branco'.

--surface-warm.reason: The second charcoal tier 'carvao-2' is the only other surface the palette declares; kept as the tertiary (dark-warm) surface.

--fg.reason: Body ink and the dark canvases (hero, faixa, footer) are 'carvao'.

--fg-2.reason: Secondary dark-warm tier from the declared palette.

--muted.reason: Supporting text is ink at reduced alpha (field placeholder #16130f99; pill sublines at opacity .8).

--border.reason: Visible edges on light surfaces are full charcoal rings (the white seal's 3px inset ring, the tooltip's 3px ring) — the sticker look.

--border-soft.reason: The only hairline separators are the drawer rows, cream at 16% on charcoal.

--accent.reason: Cheddar is the brand accent: hero script line, first menu panel, nav underline, seals, footer wordmark.

--accent-on.reason: Text placed on cheddar is always charcoal.

--success.reason: The palette's only green is 'mate' (yerba-mate); it is the natural success hue if the system needs one.

--warn.reason: The form's validation notice is set in cheddar; no separate warning hue exists.

--danger.reason: The palette's red is 'tomate'; it carries the secondary CTA and is the natural danger hue.

--font-display.value: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
--font-display.reason: Display lines are Bricolage Grotesque Variable at weight 800 with opsz 96 and a condensed wdth axis (88–94).

--font-body.value: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
--font-body.reason: Body copy is the same variable grotesque at opsz 14.

--text-xs.reason: Footer lines, tooltip and the 'toca aqui' doodle label.

--text-base.reason: Body, buttons, nav links and the e-mail field.

--text-lg.reason: Featured body paragraph in the story section at 1280px+.

--text-2xl.reason: Section title scale (nickname section; menu-panel titles resolve to 54px at 1440).

--text-3xl.reason: Hero H1 bold line (container-relative on the page).

--space-2.reason: Nav caret gap, footer link gap.

--space-3.reason: Brand lockup gap, form notice offset.

--space-4.reason: The site's 'small' step is 14px (button icon gap, form gap).

--space-5.reason: Field inline padding and the header's side gutter.

--space-6.reason: Drawer padding and story container gutter.

--space-8.reason: Button inline padding and drawer bottom padding.

--space-12.reason: Gap between the story seals at 1280px+.

--section-y-tablet.reason: The same padding scales by --su = min(1px, 100vw/1280) between 768 and 1280px.

--radius-sm.reason: Buttons and menu pills use the hand-cut 'bread' radius (pão-a), relative to their own font size.

--radius-md.reason: Photo cards in the footer mural.

--radius-pill.reason: Skip link, tooltip and the menu's side dot rail.

--elev-flat.reason: Most surfaces are flat colour fields.

--elev-ring.reason: The 3px charcoal ring around the tooltip.

--focus-ring.reason: Focus is a 3px solid outline (offset 3px) in charcoal on light grounds and cheddar on dark grounds.

--motion-fast.reason: Nav links, drawer rows and dropdown options.

--ease-standard.reason: The site's 'sai' (exit) curve drives arrow, mascot and carousel motion.

--container-max.reason: The story section's content container (header 1500px, footer 1290px, canvases 1920px).

--container-gutter-phone.reason: Phone gutter for the story grid and the mural.
